Based on the test and the description provided, it appears that the issue lies in the matrix being used for testing. It's possible that the second matrix provided in the bug report is not properly formatted or defined, leading to unexpected behavior when used in the test case.

To further diagnose the issue, we may need to inspect how the matrix is being constructed and processed in the `CholeskyDecompositionImpl` class.

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).
